ModMetaData.name: Wake-Up: Loading Optimizations
ModMetaData.author: kt-nyx
ModMetaData.description:
Private Wake-Up 1.7 testing candidate. Reviewed for 1.7.4982 rev1280 and the recorded Harmony 3.0.0-rc.3 build; other builds retain ordinary loading. Does not require or support Prepatcher on 1.7.
Reduces selected repeated definition, code type and member searches. Translation member reuse is optional and duplicate translation checking stays native. Each operation checks compatibility and retains ordinary loading when unsupported. Restart after changing settings.
RimWorld keeps ownership of textures, asset preparation, caching, loading screens and background loading. Earlier loading before Wake-Up's mod constructor is not observed. This candidate has offline validation only; gameplay correctness and loading-time improvements require later in-game testing. Not authorized for publication.
